crossRefs.note: That same day, Yahweh brought the children of Israel out of the land of Egypt by their armies.
Thus Yahweh saved Israel that day out of the hand of the Egyptians; and Israel saw the Egyptians dead on the seashore.
Israel saw the great work which Yahweh did to the Egyptians, and the people feared Yahweh; and they believed in Yahweh…
“I am Yahweh your God, who brought you out of the land of Egypt, out of the house of bondage.

people.name: Aaron
people.line: Moses' brother, first high priest of Israel

people.name: Egypt
people.line: Ancient nation; Israelites enslaved there; plagues and Exodus

people.name: Miriam
people.line: Moses' sister, a prophetess who led women in worship.

people.name: Moses
people.line: Prophet who led Israel out of Egypt

translations.web: For I brought you up out of the land of Egypt, and redeemed you out of the house of bondage. I sent before you Moses, Aaron, and Miriam.
translations.bsb: For I brought you up from the land of Egypt and redeemed you from the house of slavery. I sent Moses before you, as well as Aaron and Miriam.
translations.kjv: For I brought thee up out of the land of Egypt, and redeemed thee out of the house of servants; and I sent before thee Moses, Aaron, and Miriam.
translations.asv: For I brought thee up out of the land of Egypt, and redeemed thee out of the house of bondage; and I sent before thee Moses, Aaron, and Miriam.
